notes: Retry run. Hard constraints hit: the session's WebSearch quota was already exhausted (200/200) so all seven planned web searches (Vimeo, conference archives, SlideShare, app stores, processor-republished guides) could not run; results are YouTube (yt-dlp) plus WebFetch only. Seven of the nine supplied handles (@JCBglobal, @UnionPayInternational, @Interac, @RuPay, @EloCartoes, plus guesses @JCBInternational, @UnionPayIntl, @InteracCorp) returned zero videos through yt-dlp - handles are likely wrong or channels are not at those URLs; only @AustralianPaymentsPlus (19) and @NPCI_NPCI (200, capped) listed. YouTube search for 'JCB' is swamped by the construction-equipment company; UnionPay, Interac, eftpos, girocard and Elo partner queries returned nothing on-topic. No video anywhere shows a gated portal, sandbox, certification tool or dispute tooling in motion, so there are zero high-priority items. Page reads: AP+ /docs/ is gated behind Auth0 login (observed); girocard Produktentwicklung is gated at girocard-download.eu/login; cartes-bancaires.com returns 403 to fetchers; partner.jcbcard.com and developer.interac.ca did not resolve from this host; open.unionpayintl.com, npci.org.in and dev.elo.com.br are JS-rendered and returned only titles. Upload dates were not fetched (would have exceeded the 25-call budget), so 'published' is n.d. throughout. Recommended follow-up: rerun with WebSearch quota, resolve correct channel handles (search 'JCB Global', 'UnionPay International', 'Interac Corp', 'Elo Cartões' as channel names), and use a browser session for the JS-rendered portals.
